name: github-project-uploader
description: Choose a local project, self-check for exposed credentials, then preflight and upload an exact commit to GitHub after confirmation.

interface.shortDescription: Pick projects, check secrets, and upload to GitHub
interface.longDescription: Choose a registered local project or a non-repository project directory inside a larger Git repository. Run a local self-check for likely API keys, tokens, credentials, and history findings without signing in to GitHub. For uploading, run a separate bounded preflight and push one exact commit under the currently authenticated personal GitHub account after explicit confirmation. Repositories are private by default.
defaultPrompt: 选择一个项目上传到 GitHub
检查这个项目有没有 API Key 或 Token 泄漏
把当前项目加入 GitHub 上传列表
对这个项目执行 GitHub 上传预检
